plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for EfficientIP network service device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory used, temperature, power supply status, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2440).
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: cpu_load
metrics.description: Per-core CPU load average of the EfficientIP appliance from eipHwCpuLoadInt (PEN 2440.1.14.8.1). The device reports the floating-point load multiplied by 100; the query divides by 100 to restore the load-average value.

metrics.name: memory_used
metrics.description: Percentage of used physical memory on the EfficientIP appliance from eipHwMemUsed (PEN 2440.1.14.9.1), reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the EfficientIP appliance from eipHwTempCpu (PEN 2440.1.14.3.1), reported directly in degrees Celsius.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: PSU-1 operational state from eipHwPsu1Status (PEN 2440.1.14.5.2). Value 1 (AC connected) is healthy; disabled, present-unplugged, not-present and unknown values are treated as fault.

metrics.name: network_service_dns_service_state
metrics.description: DNS service state from eipSvcDnsStatus (PEN 2440.1.16.8.1). Value 1 (running) is healthy; disabled, misconfigured, failed and unknown values are treated as fault.

metrics.name: network_service_dns_cpu
metrics.description: DNS service CPU utilization of the EfficientIP appliance from eipSvcDnsCpu (PEN 2440.1.16.8.2), reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: network_service_dhcp_service_state
metrics.description: DHCP service state from eipSvcDhcpStatus (PEN 2440.1.16.6.1). Value 1 (running) is healthy; disabled, misconfigured, failed and unknown values are treated as fault.

metrics.name: network_service_dhcp_cpu
metrics.description: DHCP service CPU utilization of the EfficientIP appliance from eipSvcDhcpCpu (PEN 2440.1.16.6.2), reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: network_service_database_cpu
metrics.description: Database service CPU utilization of the EfficientIP appliance from eipSvcDatabaseCpu (PEN 2440.1.16.5.2), reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
